name: Steven Danneman
biography: Steven Danneman is a Security Engineer at Security Innovation in Seattle, WA, making software more secure through targeted penetration testing. Previously, he lead the development team responsible for all authentication and identity management within the OneFS operating system. Steven is also a finance geek, who opens bank accounts as a hobby and loves a debate about the efficient-market hypothesis. @sdanndev, https://www.linkedin.com/in/sdanneman/, sdann-dev.blogspot.com
